name: Power BI Modeling MCP SSE Bridge
description: This MCP server provides a web-ready SSE bridge for Microsoft's Power BI Modeling MCP Server, enabling URL-based interaction with Power BI semantic models from any programming language without local stdio piping. It features automatic Azure authentication and dynamic binary resolution for seamless Power BI data analysis.
